direct_official_checks: HMLR GML is supplied as an open GIS data structure
HMLR polygon data is captured against British National Grid
polygon points use BNG X and Y values
QGIS can reproject BNG data to other CRS
Google and Bing style maps require reprojection from BNG
EPSG:27700 is the British National Grid CRS cited by HMLR guidance
BNG to WGS84 conversion may shift some features by up to 15 metres
quality_effect: Forces candidate binding in native BNG and treats WGS84 reprojection as a display/interop step, not authoritative parcel geometry.
